deployments_detail.use: ArchIQ ('Archy') generative-AI drive-thru voice ordering and restaurant-operations platform, taking orders in English and Spanish; in limited testing at five US locations, having processed over one million transactions with ~90% of orders completed without escalation to staff. [Google (Google Edge Cloud)]
deployments_detail.value: ~90% of orders completed without staff escalation; 1M+ transactions processed

deployments_detail.use: Automated Order Taking (AOT) AI voice ordering at the drive-thru, tested in partnership with IBM at 100+ US restaurants beginning 2021; McDonald's ended the global AOT partnership with IBM and removed the technology (switched off by late July 2024) after accuracy shortfalls. [IBM]

Acquisition of Apprente, a 'sound-to-meaning' voice AI startup, to build multilingual conversational voice ordering for the drive-thru; folded into the new McD Tech Labs unit (later sold to IBM in 2021), forming the foundation of McDonald's automated voice-ordering effort. [Apprente (McD Tech Labs)]
Named as a Databricks customer/case study [Databricks] [Databricks]

Strategic partnership with Google Cloud to apply generative AI and edge computing across restaurants worldwide, deploying Google Distributed Cloud hardware/software on-site for low-latency analytics, mobile app/loyalty optimization, kiosk improvements and equipment monitoring; thousands of restaurants began receiving upgrades from 2024. [Google Cloud (Google Distributed Cloud, Vertex AI)]
"ArchIQ" AI platform (Google Cloud) — drive-thru voice ordering (multilingual, ~90% accuracy) + manager assist

Edge-computing AI predictive maintenance: sensors on kitchen equipment feed AI that detects early signs of failure (fryers, McFlurry/ice cream machines) to reduce downtime, rolling out to restaurants as part of the Google Cloud edge deployment announced in 2025. [Google Cloud (edge computing)]

McHire hiring platform with AI conversational chatbot 'Olivia' (built by Paradox.ai) that screens applicants, collects resumes and administers personality tests to speed hourly hiring; in production and used at scale (a 2025 security flaw exposed records of tens of millions of applicants, confirming live use). [Paradox.ai (Olivia)]

'Apply Thru' voice job-application assistant letting candidates start a McDonald's job application via Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant ('Alexa, help me get a job at McDonald's'); launched live in the US, Canada and other markets in 2019. [Amazon Alexa; Google Assistant]

Computer-vision order-accuracy checking: fixed cameras in the kitchen use AI to verify orders for accuracy before they are handed to the customer, described as part of McDonald's 2025 restaurant AI/edge rollout. [Google Cloud]

Development of a 'generative AI virtual manager' to handle administrative tasks such as shift scheduling and inventory for restaurant managers, disclosed as part of the plan to deploy AI tools across ~43,000 restaurants. [none]

Dynamic Yield decision-technology / machine-learning personalization of outdoor digital drive-thru menu boards and in-store kiosks, varying displayed items by weather, time of day, trending items and current order to suggest add-ons; acquired 2019, deployed across US drive-thrus, later sold to Mastercard (closed April 2022) with McDonald's continuing to use the technology. [Dynamic Yield (McDonald's-owned 2019-2022, then Mastercard)]
